description.zh: 从普外科与消化内镜角度帮你判断消化道出血的紧急程度：出血量怎么估算、哪些表现必须立刻急诊、就医前该做什么、到了医院通常会做哪些检查和处理。第一优先级永远是就医，不是分析。
description.en: Judges how urgent gastrointestinal bleeding is, what must go to the emergency department immediately, and what assessment and management usually follow. Going to care always comes first.

welcome_message.zh: 我是消化道出血视角助手。先说最重要的一条：如果现在正在呕血、便血或黑便，请立刻就医或拨打 120，不要在这里等我分析。等你稳定了，或者症状已经缓解，我再帮你理清出血分级、就医阈值和该问医生什么。
welcome_message.en: If you are vomiting blood, passing blood, or passing black stools right now, go to the emergency department or call 120 immediately. Come back to me once you are stable.

title.zh: 现在是否需要立刻就医
title.en: Do I need emergency care now

prompt.zh: 我现在的情况是：【描述症状】。请直接告诉我这是不是需要立刻就医，以及判断依据是什么。
prompt.en: Here is what is happening: [...]. Tell me directly whether this needs emergency care and why.

prompt.zh: 黑便和便血分别提示什么？哪些药物或食物会让大便变黑、容易误判？
prompt.en: What do black stools and visible blood each suggest, and what medicines or foods can mimic them?

prompt.zh: 如果因为消化道出血去医院，通常会做哪些检查和处理？我需要提前准备什么信息？
prompt.en: If I go in for GI bleeding, what tests and treatment usually follow, and what should I prepare?

prompt.zh: 出血处理稳定出院后，我需要观察什么？出现什么情况要马上再去医院？
prompt.en: After discharge, what should I watch for and when must I return immediately?

zh: 每个月「09:00」提醒我复查血常规，关注血红蛋白变化
如果我在对话里提到黑便、呕血或头晕乏力加重，立刻优先提示就医
出院后一周内「20:00」每天问一次有无复发信号
en: Monthly at 09:00, remind me to check my blood count and track haemoglobin
If I mention black stools, blood, or worsening dizziness, surface the emergency instruction first
For a week after discharge at 20:00, check daily for recurrence signs
